comments.name: Jim Aubrey
comments.comment: June 8, 2026. G'day Jeremy, my website is hopelessly out of date. My activism is not. My new brief essay, Bougainville, West Papua and Schadenfreude, can be accessed on my academia profile. This is the precursor to my 350-page AN EXTRAORDINARY AUTOPSY-AFFIDAVIT - The Genocide Paradox: West Papua and the case against the Commonwealth of Australia, which includes an 8-page affidavit. The entire thing will soon be presented to the Commonwealth Director of Public Prosecutions and the AFP Commissioner. The general idea is in the brief essay now on academia. You will not find me on Facebook or Messenger. I was given my marching orders before the last federal election. Let us, with courage, be bold. Respectfully and ever yours in peace and solidarity, Jim Aubrey, Genocide Rebellion - Free West Papua Chapter Australia.
